category_edits.rationale: Keep Adam and the TPE-selected peak learning rate, with linear warmup over epochs 1–5 followed by cosine decay to 10% of peak at epoch 200. Smoother early updates and smaller late updates may improve validation stability. Preserve all other training settings, architecture, loss, routing, and single-checkpoint selection.

change_summary: Add five-epoch learning-rate warmup and cosine decay through epoch 200 for each category’s SASRec model.
